line_format: {"sse_id": <SSE id: line, verbatim>, "event": <SSE data: JSON object>}
transformation: performer.user_text, revision.editor.user_text, prior_state.revision.editor.user_text: replaced with consistent placeholders by shape class (registered -> FixtureUser<N>; temporary account ~YYYY-NNNNN-NN -> ~YYYY-<N 5 digits>-<N mod 100>, year kept; IP address -> 192.0.2.<N>, none present)
performer.user_id, revision.editor.user_id, prior_state.revision.editor.user_id: non-zero values remapped per (wiki_id, user_id) to consistent integers from 1000001
performer.user_central_id, revision.editor.user_central_id, prior_state.revision.editor.user_central_id: non-zero values remapped to consistent integers from 2000001
comment, revision.comment, prior_state.revision.comment: replaced with 'fixture comment <N>', consistent per distinct original value

page_title of page, page.redirect_page_link, prior_state.page and created_redirect_page when namespace_id is 2 (User) or 3 (User talk): the user name after the localised namespace prefix is replaced with the same placeholder as that user's user_text (a new FixtureUser<N> when the name is not an editor in the capture); the prefix and subpage suffix are kept, except that known user names inside the subpage suffix are also replaced
meta.uri: the title part is re-encoded from the replaced page_title when it pointed at a replaced title
performer and editor edit_count, registration_dt, first_edit_dt and groups are kept as captured: they are input the ingest service must drop
all other fields verbatim; the same original value always maps to the same placeholder, so distinct-editor counts are preserved
capture_notes: 9 connections; the server closed each after about 2.3 minutes and the capture resumed with Last-Event-ID. Events replayed across a reconnect were kept once (by meta.id). 2 canary events (examplewiki) arrived and are kept.
